issues.description: fieldsWriter throws UnsupportedOperationException while public constructors and SPI registration remain, deferring failure to write time
issues.detail: Both legacy formats are still public, SPI-listed, and instantiable, but fieldsWriter throws at use. This violates KnnVectorsFormat's contract (LSP) and pushes failure from construction to first index flush. Either fail in the constructor pointing at Lucene104, introduce a ReadOnlyKnnVectorsFormat supertype, or remove the public constructors and SPI entries.

issues.description: DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT duplicated instead of sourced from canonical on-disk format spec
issues.detail: The constant was previously imported from Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat and is now redeclared package-private in Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat. Two sources of truth for the same on-disk parameter risk silent drift if the canonical value ever changes. Re-import from the original or move it to a shared spec class in backward_codecs.

issues.description: Public API surface (NAME, QUANTIZED_VECTOR_COMPONENT, calculateDefaultConfidenceInterval) demoted to package-private without a deprecation cycle
issues.detail: These were public symbols on a released format class. Narrowing visibility in the same release as the relocation is an undeclared ABI break for external callers. Leave them public-and-deprecated for one cycle before removal, or restore visibility.

issues.description: OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues fields silently downgraded from protected to package-private on a still-public abstract class
issues.detail: The class remains public abstract, so external subtypes are nominally invited, but the previously protected fields are now package-private, leaving no usable extension surface. Either seal/finalize the class to close the hierarchy or restore the protected contract; don't ship a public ADT with no extension path.

issues.description: Dropped numMergeWorkers/mergeExec parameters silently ignored in deprecated constructors
issues.detail: The legacy constructor still accepts and null-checks numMergeWorkers and mergeExec but no longer stores them. The signature lies about what the arguments do. Drop them or add a literate comment stating they are accepted only for source-compat and ignored because writes are disabled.

issues.description: Test RW subclasses restore writes via inheritance, coupling to newly package-private fields
issues.detail: Lucene99RWScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat and the V1 HNSW variant extend read-only formats and override fieldsWriter, reaching into package-private fields. This is inheritance-for-reuse that re-violates substitutability and motivates the awkward visibility narrowing. Prefer composition or a protected createWriter() hook on the production class.

synthesis.summary: The relocation of Lucene99 scalar-quantized formats into backward_codecs is directionally correct, but the contract and API work is incomplete. The dominant concern is that fieldsWriter throws at use-time while the public constructors and SPI registrations remain, violating KnnVectorsFormat's contract and deferring failure past construction. A duplicated DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT constant introduces an on-disk-format drift risk, and several visibility changes (public symbols demoted, protected fields narrowed) ship as undeclared ABI breaks without a deprecation cycle. The patch should be split into move, visibility, and write-disable steps, with a ReadOnlyKnnVectorsFormat supertype or constructor-time refusal expressing the read-only invariant in the type system.
